unicode_normalization: NONE; XML character decoding only; generated notation tokens use ASCII
document_order: UTF-8 bytewise lexical order of archive entry path
event_order: measure ordinal, exact rational onset, part id, voice id, source event ordinal

boundaries.section: unobserved for R1/R3; source part/voice/staff sequence for R2
boundaries.physical_line: MusicXML print/@new-page or print/@new-system, numbered from one

events.rests: retained in MUSIC-R1, reset interval continuity in MUSIC-R2, excluded from MUSIC-R3
events.chords: members retain the preceding event onset and a source_chord_member attribute
events.ties: notated segments remain separate MUSIC-R1/R3 events; tie type is preserved in MUSIC-R1
events.backup_forward: applied exactly to the per-measure MusicXML cursor

representations.MUSIC-R1: one notated note/rest event; ordered symbols are kind, pitch class and register when pitched, exact quarter-duration fraction, explicit accidental, tie state
representations.MUSIC-R2: signed semitone interval between consecutive pitched events in the same document/part/voice/staff; rests reset continuity; source voice is an observed sequence section
representations.MUSIC-R3: one pitched event represented by exact spelled pitch times exact quarter-duration fraction

metadata_policy: lyrics, credits, beams, stems, colors, engraving coordinates, MIDI instruments, and editorial display metadata are excluded because they are outside frozen MUSIC-R1/R2/R3 semantics
missing_uncertain_policy: no reading is inferred; incomplete pitch, absent duration/divisions, negative cursor, or absent initial encoded page/system boundary fails conversion
